name: rusty sword
description: A short sword of cheap iron, pitted with orange rust. The edge is notched but it would still do the job in a pinch. A maker's mark — a crude hammer — is stamped near the hilt.

name: iron chest
description: A squat chest of riveted iron, barely a foot across. It is unlocked. The hinges have turned to red dust.

name: gold coin pouch
description: A small leather pouch, heavy with gold coins. Inside the drawstring is stamped the seal of Thornwall — a tower with a broken crown.

name: old letter
description: A folded sheet of heavy vellum, sealed with wax that has long since crumbled. The ink is brown with age but still legible.
read_text: To whoever holds this letter: I write in haste. The thing beneath the undercroft is awake. We cannot destroy it — we have only managed to seal it below the flagstones. If you are reading this, the seal has been broken. God help you. — Steward Aldric, Year of the Crow

name: leather satchel
description: A worn leather satchel with a brass buckle. Well-made despite its age — the stitching is still tight.

name: strip of dried meat
description: A tough strip of salted, dried meat — venison, maybe. Still edible. Probably.

name: carved wooden idol
description: A small figurine of dark wood, carved into the rough shape of a hunched figure with too many fingers. The eyes are inlaid chips of yellow amber. It gives you an uneasy feeling.

name: engraved tablet
description: A flat slate tablet, roughly the size of a book. Symbols are engraved in neat rows — not any alphabet you recognise.
read_text: The symbols shift as you stare at them. You think — just for a moment — that you can read them: 'THAT WHICH SLEEPS BELOW DOES NOT DREAM. IT WAITS.' You set the tablet down quickly.
